officialName: Notice of Opposition to Amendment / Restoration / Surrender of Patent / Grant of Compulsory Licence or Revision of Terms Thereof or to Correction of Clerical Errors
purpose: A single notice-of-opposition form covering six distinct opposition scenarios, selected by the opponent: opposition to an amendment, to restoration, to surrender, to grant of a compulsory licence or revocation, to revision of licence terms, or to correction of a clerical error.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries numbered instructions (1-4); right column presents six mutually exclusive opposition types joined by 'OR'. The opponent selects one type; only the selected branch is retained (the rest struck out on export). Option 6 (clerical error) references several numbers/dates, shown conditionally.

sections.title: Opponent Particulars
sections.description: Instruction 1: name, address and nationality of the opponent(s).

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single opponent, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the opponent(s)
fields.helpText: Full name(s) (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the opponent's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: Type of Opposition
sections.description: Choose one of the six opposition types (joined by 'OR' on the printed form). Only the selected branch is retained; the rest are struck out on export.

options.label: to the amendment of the application/specification with respect to application for Patent No. ... dated ...
to the application for restoration of Patent No. ... dated ...
to the offer to surrender the Patent No. ... dated ...
for the grant of compulsory licence, or revocation of Patent No. ... dated ...
for the revision of the terms and conditions of licence in respect of Patent No. ... dated ...
for correction of a clerical error in Patent No. ... dated ... / Specification No. ... dated ... in respect of Patent No. ... dated ... or Patent application No. ... dated ...

autofill.derivation: Infer from the underlying proceeding if that document was uploaded; the user confirms.

fields.label: Specification No. (clerical error)
fields.helpText: For a clerical-error opposition: the specification number in which the error appears.

fields.label: Patent application No. (clerical error, if applicable)
fields.helpText: For a clerical-error opposition where the error is in a patent application rather than a granted patent.

validation.patternMessage: Expected an IPO application number, e.g. 202211012345 or 1234/DEL/2015.

fields.label: Patent application dated (clerical error, if applicable)

sections.title: Grounds of Opposition
sections.description: 'The grounds in which the said opposition is made are as follows:'

validation.message: State at least one ground of opposition.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 2: complete address incl postal index number/code and state along with telephone and fax number(s).

fields.label: My/Our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number(s).

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

sections.title: To be signed by the opponent or his authorised registered patent agent.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the opponent's address or the office where the patent was granted.

attachments.label: Written statement and evidence in support of the opposition
attachments.note: Typically accompanies the notice per the relevant opposition rule, though not enumerated as a field on the form face.

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable: select one of the six opposition types; the rest are struck out on export.
Option 6 (correction of a clerical error) references additional numbers/dates (specification and, where the error is in an application, the patent application), shown only when that type is selected.

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: NOTICE OF OPPOSITION TO AMENDMENT / RESTORATION / SURRENDER OF PATENT / GRANT OF COMPULSORY LICENCE OR REVISION OF TERMS THEREOF OR TO CORRECTION OF CLERICAL ERRORS
